hypothesis: ensureInventoryLevels (called from createReservationItems_) validates every entry of the batch against the same static available_quantity from the level map, never subtracting what earlier entries in the same batch claim. A single cart with two lines sharing the WIDGET inventory item (OVS-PIECE qty 6 and OVS-TWOPACK qty 3, i.e. 6 + 6 = 12 units against 10 stocked) should therefore pass the reservation check on complete, creating reservations totaling 12 against 10 stock. I expect no_oversell to fail (live reservations exceed stock and the order needs more units than stocked) and reserved_matches_reservations to possibly hold since both are written from the same sum.
